name: service-version-ui
description: ヘッダで稼働中のビルド版数を表示し、キャッシュが古い画面を利用者が判別できるようにする。
cardTemplate: Summarise the service-version-ui domain: rendering the build version beside the brand and preserving a visible runtime identity for stale-cache diagnosis.
rationale: Build identity generation and cache recovery remain owned by build-freshness; this domain owns only the user-visible version presentation and its regression coverage.
